program.name: Supersets & Stretch
program.subject: Strength & stretch
program.blurb: Dumbbell supersets, heavier each level, then a long stretch for what you trained.
program.about: Supersets with dumbbells or a kettlebell, then a long stretch. Push days pair presses with rows and finish with the chest and shoulders opened; leg days pair squats with hinges and finish with the hips and hamstrings. The supersets get heavier at both later levels and the stretches hold longer. A good way to stay mobile while you get strong.
